title: 第十三章 云舟梦痕
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
回想此方世界共分神，仙，人，魔，鬼，妖六界，除人修外，亦有魔修，鬼修，妖修并存，实为光怪陆离，万象纷呈，包括修行也分练气至渡劫九境，渡劫成功即可飞升登仙。

    联想到原身所在的天极仙府乃九大仙门之首，有师尊这位正道第一人坐镇，其余八派虽各有千秋，却无出其右，别的小的宗门更是数不胜数。

    男主司楚白一路斩妖除魔，机缘不断，堪称天道宠儿，而暗处的反派更是修为深不可测，在这般世道之下，别说追随主角阵营，即便只想求个安稳长生，除了倚仗师尊庇护之外，也只能自身勤修修炼，步步为营，才有可能自保了。

    想起原书中记载，近万年来，几乎无人成功渡劫飞升，除了那位天命所归的男主司楚白，她如今仅是金丹中期，不知何时才能突破。至少须到元婴期修为，才算有两分自保之力。

    下定决心后，回去定要追随师尊潜心修行，绝不与主角团牵连过深，还要寻机会探查原身父母下落，思及此，她心中微微一叹，还是先不想解决不了的了。

    转念，思想又抛锚，想到慕宸，想到自己丢脸的事，轻哼了句：“去去去你就是我老板，等将来我修为足以纵横六界，还不找十个八个清风霁月的小仙君？”

    她转了一圈，沮丧地发现，这艘流光溢彩的云纹飞舟上，竟什么吃的也没有。

    “师弟。”她拉住一个路过的青衣弟子，话出口才意识到叫错了辈分，也猛地惊觉，原身早已辟谷多年，自己这般贪嘴，若在师尊面前露了馅，被当作夺舍可怎么办？瞬间惊出一身冷汗。

    没完全摸透情况之前，还是尽量避开他们为妙。

    那弟子身姿挺拔，比谢清猗高出半头，样貌斯文俊秀，此时他稍显疑惑地望来：“谢师叔，您很热吗？怎的额间有汗？”

    “无事，功法运转之故。”她强作镇定，袖中指尖悄悄掐了个清凉诀，“我是想问，可有灵茶灵点？”

    “飞舟上备有灵果，不过要明日清晨方有供应。师叔可需用茶？现有红茶，白茶，黄茶，青茶与黑茶。“小弟子依旧神情恭敬，语态端正，袖口银丝绣着的云纹在廊间明珠映照下泛着浅浅流光。

    “只有茶啊……“谢清猗的目光落在他衣襟那枚外门弟子的翠色玉牌上，想起方才那声脱口而出的师弟，耳根微热，她将视线移向窗外，暮色渐沉，飞舟正穿行于云海之上。

    她忽觉出一点不对，茶叶不是六大分类吗，怎么少了一个，脱口问道：“怎么没有绿茶？”

    小弟子从容一笑：“回师叔，宗门里的绿茶需以灵莲为引，方能彰显其独特韵味。眼下灵莲暂缺，故未准备此茶。”

    谢清猗一怔，表情有些怪异，是她理解的那个意思吗？应该是她想多了吧，可这绿茶非要这么泡才能喝吗？不就是荷香绿茶，小说世界还真是奇奇怪怪。

    “无妨，那就白茶吧。”她抬手轻拍了下少年的肩，转身时又想起什么，回头补充道，“劳烦直接送到我房中，多谢。”

    “好的师叔！”少年眼睛清亮，对着她渐远的背影稍稍提高声音，“弟子名叫贺俊宇！”

    “知道啦，小贺。”谢清猗唇角轻扬，朝他挥挥手，便径直回了房间。

    不过片刻，门外便传来轻叩声。她开门一看，一个木制傀儡小人稳稳托着茶盘，盘中一盏青瓷茶壶正冒着灵气，傀儡眼眸处嵌着的灵石微微发光，为免扰修士清修，这类杂务向来由它们去做，倒是和现代一样方便。

    灌了满肚子茶水后，谢清猗从芥子袋中取出一枚辟谷丹，刚放入口中嚼了两下，便“呸呸”连声吐了出来，这黑乎乎的东西真是辟谷丹？

    分明是怪味泥丸子！她狐疑地端详着手中丹药，原身的记忆确实如此，可这滋味实在令人难以下咽，她悻悻地将剩余的丹药收回袋中。

    她本不是贪嘴之人，可眼下什么吃食都没有，实在煎熬。在房里转了几圈，终是意兴阑珊地倒回床榻，盯着雕刻着聚灵阵纹的舱顶发呆，天极仙府究竟还有多远……

    谢清猗把玩着从储物戒中取出的一把玉扇，扇骨流转着冰蓝灵光，开合间沁着冰凉触感，样式清雅玲珑，甚合她心意。

    她心中一愣，嗯～怎么又文邹邹的？难道被原身影响太大？马上换OS系统，应该是，好喜欢～美美哒～
content_en:
Recall that this world is divided into six realms: gods, immortals, humans, demons, ghosts, and demons. In addition to human cultivation, there are also demons, ghosts, and demons who coexist.

    Reminiscent of the fact that the Tianji Immortal Mansion where the original body is located is the head of the nine immortal sects, with the master, the first person in the righteous way, sitting in charge. Although the other eight sects have their own merits, none of them can surpass them, and there are countless other small sects.

    The male protagonist Si Chubai has been slaying demons and slaying demons all the way. Opportunities are endless and he can be called the darling of heaven. The villain in the dark is even more unfathomable. In such a world, let alone following the protagonist's camp, even if he just wants a stable and eternal life, in addition to relying on the protection of his master, he can only practice diligently and practice step by step to be able to protect himself.

    Recalling the records in the original book, in the past ten thousand years, almost no one has successfully transcended the tribulation and ascended, except for Si Chubai, the hero who was destined to be the hero. She is now only in the middle stage of the Golden Core, and she doesn't know when she will be able to break through. You must at least cultivate to the Nascent Soul stage before you can be considered capable of protecting yourself.

    After making up her mind, she would follow her master and practice with concentration when she returned. She would never get too involved with the protagonist group, and she would also look for opportunities to find out the whereabouts of her original parents. Thinking of this, she sighed slightly in her heart, and she still wanted to stop thinking about things she couldn't solve.

    Then he thought about it again. He thought of Mu Chen and the embarrassing thing he had done, and he hummed: "Go, go, you are my boss. In the future, when I have cultivated enough to travel across the six realms, why don't I find ten or eight little immortal kings like Qingfeng Jiyue?"

    She turned around and found to her dismay that there was nothing to eat on board this colorful, cloud-patterned flying boat.

    "Junior brother." She grabbed a passing disciple in Tsing Yi and realized that she had called the wrong seniority when she spoke. She was also shocked to realize that she had been abstaining from the world for many years. She was so greedy. What if she exposed her secrets in front of the master and was treated as someone who had taken away her body? Instantly broke into a cold sweat.

    Before you fully understand the situation, it is better to avoid them as much as possible.

    The disciple was tall and straight, half a head taller than Xie Qingyi, with a graceful and handsome appearance. At this time, he looked at him with a little doubt: "Uncle Xie, are you very hot? Why is there sweat on your forehead?"

    "It's okay, it's just because the technique is working." She forced herself to calm down and secretly pinched a cooling trick with her fingertips on her sleeve, "I just wanted to ask, is there any spiritual tea?"

    "There are spiritual fruits on the flying boat, but they will not be available until early tomorrow morning. Master, can I use tea? There are black tea, white tea, yellow tea, green tea and black tea." The young disciple still looked respectful and spoke upright. The cloud pattern embroidered with silver thread on his sleeves shone lightly under the reflection of the pearls in the corridor.

    "Only tea..." Xie Qingyi's eyes fell on the emerald jade badge of an outer disciple on the lapel of his clothes. Thinking of the junior disciple who blurted out just now, her ears felt slightly warm. She moved her gaze to the window. The dusk was getting darker, and the flying boat was passing through the sea of ​​clouds.

    She suddenly realized something was wrong. Isn't there six categories of tea? Why was one missing? She blurted out, "Why is there no green tea?"

    The young disciple smiled calmly: "Back to my uncle, the green tea in our sect needs to be made with spirit lotus to show its unique flavor. At the moment, spirit lotus is in short supply, so we haven't prepared this tea."

    Xie Qingyi was startled, with a strange expression. Did she understand what it meant? She must be overthinking it, but does this green tea have to be brewed like this before you can drink it? Isn't it just lotus scented green tea? The world of the novel is really weird.

    "It doesn't matter, let's have some white tea." She raised her hand and patted the young man's shoulder. When she turned around, she thought of something and turned around and added, "Send it to my room directly, thank you."

    "Okay, uncle!" The young man's eyes were clear and he raised his voice slightly towards her retreating back, "The disciple's name is He Junyu!"

    "I know, Xiao He." Xie Qingyi raised the corners of her lips, waved to him, and went straight back to the room.

    After a moment, there was a light knock on the door. When she opened the door, she saw a small wooden puppet holding the tea tray steadily. A celadon teapot on the tray was emitting spiritual energy. The spiritual stones embedded in the puppet's eyes shone slightly, so as not to disturb the monks' cleaning. They had always done such chores, and it was as convenient as modern times.

    After filling his stomach with tea, Xie Qingyi took out a Bigu Pill from the mustard bag. He put it in his mouth and chewed it twice before spitting it out. Is this black thing really a Bigu Pill?

    They are clearly weird-tasting clay balls! She looked at the elixir in her hand suspiciously. The memory of the original person was indeed like this, but the taste was really unpalatable, so she put the remaining elixir back into her bag angrily.

    She was not a greedy person, but now she had nothing to eat and was really suffering. After walking around the room for a few times, he finally fell back on the bed in a daze, staring blankly at the cabin roof engraved with the spirit-gathering formation pattern, wondering how far away the Tianji Immortal Mansion was...

    Xie Qingyi played with a jade fan she took out from the storage ring. The fan's bones were filled with icy blue aura, and there was a cool touch when opening and closing. The style was elegant and exquisite, which suited her very much.

    She was stunned, hmm~ Why is Wen Zou Zou mentioned again? Is it too affected by the original body? Change the OS system immediately, it should be, I like it so much ~ beautiful ~
